_quarry.citation: Komnene, Anna. The Alexiad. Translated by E. R. A. Sewter, revised with introduction and notes by Peter Frankopan. London: Penguin Classics, 2009.
_quarry.notes: Greek prose biography of emperor Alexios I Komnenos (r. 1081–1118) by his daughter Anna, completed in retirement at the Kecharitomene convent around 1148. Sewter's mid-20th-century English translation is the standard Penguin reading; Frankopan's 2009 revision updates the apparatus and adds substantial historical notes. Major Byzantine source on the First Crusade, the Norman wars against Robert Guiscard, and the Komnenian restoration.
